Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision sustained while the patient's vehicle was struck during a left-hand turn. The
reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder injury diagnosed, and the force described fits the pattern of soft
tissue damage seen in this type of impact. Over eleven visits, care included physical therapy, range-of-motion work,
and home exercise instruction. Recovery ran somewhat longer than typically expected for this injury, which we
attribute to the patient's pace of progress rather than any single setback. On examination, certain findings, including
reduced active abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff insertion, support the clinical diagnosis. Other tests,
such as neurological screening and stability assessment, returned normal results. The patient reports a minor strain
to the same region many years ago, which resolved completely without ongoing limitation and does not appear to
affect the current presentation. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same
services.

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
